How this works

A quick guide — takes ten seconds to read.

1

Browse the list

I love everything here, so you can't go wrong with anything. Browse however you like — by brand, category, or price — and sort by how much I want each piece.

2

Open a product

Tap any item to see it up close. You'll get “Add to bag” and “Buy it here.” Add to bag builds a running total (it sums up if you're getting a few things); Buy it here takes you straight to the store.

3

Keep track in your bag

Everything you add shows in the cart with prices and a total, so you always know where you stand.

4

Mark it purchased

Once you've bought something, open the cart and tap “Purchased!” at the bottom. It'll show as “Bought by someone” so nobody buys the same thing twice.

5

Copy my address

Open the menu (top-left) → Addresses, pick where to ship, and tap Copy — no switching back and forth to type it out.

The wishlist

Ordered by how much I'd love each one. Tap anything to read more and go straight to the store. Add what you're getting me to the cart to keep a running total.
